segments.title: Broadcast Sign-On and Pre-Debate Setup
segments.notes: Pepito delivers station identification; Case Blackwell prepares studio for debate night simulcast.

segments.title: Anchor Desk Opening
segments.notes: Case Blackwell welcomes chat, acknowledges technical issues, and teases Munch & Crum debate desk.

segments.title: Munch & Crum Debate Preview
segments.notes: Munch and Crum appear in golden tuxes, exchange pre-debate banter, and preview Harris vs. Trump matchup.

segments.title: Presidential Debate Simulcast and Live Commentary
segments.notes: Network carries ABC News simulcast of Harris-Trump debate; Case, Munch, and Crum provide running commentary throughout.

segments.title: Post-Debate Analysis and Argument
segments.notes: Munch and Crum clash over debate performance, election predictions, and personal grievances; Case moderates.

segments.title: Kendall's Corner: Bachelorette Drama
segments.notes: Kendall delivers unrelated entertainment news about The Bachelorette finale and explicit text leak.

segments.title: JD Vance Clip Search
segments.notes: Case attempts to locate JD Vance live footage; plays brief 16-second clip of Vance with German Shepherd.

segments.title: Sign-Off and Raid
segments.notes: Case thanks Pepito, reflects on debate night, and raids Gina Darling.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored debate night broadcast, managed simulcast cutaways, and moderated post-debate Munch & Crum argument.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered station sign-on and managed live switching during debate simulcast.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Wore golden tux for debate preview, declared himself independently conservative, and claimed debate victory for Trump.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Wore golden tux, revealed seven-year egg avoidance, and argued Harris won debate while Munch denied reality.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype correspondent. Briefly interrupted pre-show with freestyle before being sent to corner by Case.

characters.name: Kendall
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Delivered Kendall's Corner segment covering Bachelorette drama and explicit text message leak.

lore_notes.fact: Claims 'independently conservative' political alignment; says he would vote for Harris if she promised to send Crum to Djibouti or kill him.
States he has not eaten eggs in seven years.
Declares 'I fucking won that one' claiming personal debate victory; insists 'whenever I win America wins.'
Reports Bachelorette contestant Devin broke engagement via phone; ex-fiancé leaked explicit texts including 'can't wait for your mouth to be on my titties.'

episode_summary: Barely Informed News carried the ABC News simulcast of the Harris-Trump presidential debate with live commentary from Case Blackwell, Munch, and Crum. The debate covered economy, immigration, abortion, foreign policy, and January 6; Munch and Crum erupted into a post-debate shouting match over who won, ending with Munch professing love for Crum. Kendall closed the night with unrelated Bachelorette drama before Case raided Gina Darling.
